title: Case: Print firm asks about a re-attempt fee before its Friday payment run
context: Fallowmere Print disputes a GBP 24.00 failed-delivery re-attempt fee on invoice INV-1637 for shipment DL-9787. The carrier's Business billing team decides fee waivers.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send Business billing Dispatch's reason code F-07 (vehicle fault, carrier-caused) for DL-9787 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 and ask them to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt line on INV-1637.

must: Sends Business billing the Dispatch failure reason code F-07, carrier-caused vehicle fault, for DL-9787 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03
Asks Business billing to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee on INV-1637 and confirm the outcome
Treats the fee as still under review, not waived
must_not: Confirm to Jory Brackley that the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee has been credited (credit note CN-9027 is against INV-4147 for DL-4226)
Tell him to pay INV-1637 less GBP 24.00, or state a revised amount due
Promise that the fee will be waived or credited
State as the desk's own finding that the fee was charged in error
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: INV-1637, DL-9787: the information you asked for on 2026-06-08. Dispatch records attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 as not leaving the depot because of a vehicle fault, reason code F-07, carrier-caused. Attempt 2 on 2026-06-04 was delivered at 10:14. Please review the GBP 24.00 failed delivery re-attempt line on INV-1637 on that basis and confirm whether it is waived and, if so, the credit note reference and revised amount due. The customer, Fallowmere Print, has a payment run on Friday and has seen CN-9027 on its statement; that credit is against INV-4147, so a clear answer on INV-1637 before Friday would help.
